def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # validate inputs
    if logp_with_result.ndim != 2 or logp_call_only.ndim != 2 or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("All inputs must be 2D arrays")
    if logp_with_result.shape != logp_call_only.shape or logp_with_result.shape != logp_no_call.shape:
        raise ValueError("All input arrays must have the same shape")
    if logp_with_result.size == 0:
        raise ValueError("Input arrays cannot be empty")
    if not (np.isfinite(logp_with_result).all() and np.isfinite(logp_call_only).all() and np.isfinite(logp_no_call).all()):
        raise ValueError("All log probabilities must be finite")
    if not (logp_with_result <= 0).all() or not (logp_call_only <= 0).all() or not (logp_no_call <= 0).all():
        raise ValueError("All log probabilities must be nonpositive")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    H = logp_with_result.shape[1]
    t = np.arange(H, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    norm_weights = raw_weights / np.sum(raw_weights)

    L_with = -np.sum(norm_weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    L_call = -np.sum(norm_weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    L_no = -np.sum(norm_weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)

    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no, L_call)
    margin = L_minus - L_with
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
